title: Terms of Service
intro: Welcome to LectureLens. Please read these terms before your first lesson. Your acceptance is saved on this device and shared by the desktop app and extension.
agreement: I agree to the Terms of Service

sections.title: 1. Recording with permission
sections.body: Use LectureLens only for lessons you are allowed to record and process. Obtain permission from the teacher and other participants where required, and follow your institution’s rules and applicable law. Accepting these terms does not give you permission to record someone. Before each capture, starting the preview confirms that you have permission for that lesson.

sections.title: 2. What is captured
sections.body: The extension captures the lesson tab you select. Slides + voice records its audio and saves selected slide images. Voice only requests audio without screen capture or screenshots. Keep the selected tab on the intended lesson. Preview checks the source; recording begins when you choose Start recording.

sections.title: 3. Local files and retention
sections.body: Recordings are saved incrementally on this computer to support recovery. Anyone with access to your computer or exported files may be able to read them. This preview currently keeps original recordings and lesson files by default, including after PDF export. Delete recordings you no longer need using the app, and manage exported copies separately. Automatic deletion after PDF export is not yet available in this build.

sections.title: 4. Optional cloud processing
sections.body: General acceptance does not authorize image uploads. Automatic crop is optional and requires a separate choice for each session. If enabled, occasional full-tab screenshots, including content outside the final crop, are sent to Google Gemini. Google’s unpaid service may use submitted content and responses to improve its products, and human reviewers may inspect them. Do not upload sensitive or confidential content. Manual crop and voice-only capture do not need this image service. Cloud transcription and note generation send the relevant audio or text to the configured providers when you choose those features; review their notices and terms before use.

sections.title: 5. Study responsibly
sections.body: Transcripts, extracted slides and AI-generated notes can be incomplete or incorrect. Check important details against your lesson and original materials. LectureLens is a study aid, not a substitute for your teacher or professional advice. Respect copyright, privacy and academic-integrity rules when sharing recordings, transcripts or PDFs. LectureLens does not grant rights to other people’s course materials.

sections.title: 6. Preview software and service limits
sections.body: This is preview software. Capture, recovery and exports can fail; keep backups of important permitted materials. External services have their own availability, eligibility, usage limits and terms. Use your own authorized accounts and protect your API keys. Accepting these terms does not purchase a service or authorize charges.

sections.title: 7. Your choice
sections.body: You may decline by closing this notice without accepting and leaving the app. You can read these terms again in Settings or from the extension’s Terms of Service link. Acceptance is stored locally with its date and this version. If the terms change, you will be asked to accept the new version before a new capture. Acceptance applies to this device’s user profile; it is not an online account.
